csharpCode: using UnityEngine; using Unity.Netcode.Components; using UnityEditor; public class CheckPlayerAnimators { public static string Run() { string log = ""; GameObject prefab = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameObject>("Assets/Prefabs/Player.prefab"); if (prefab == null) return "No player prefab"; Animator anim = prefab.GetComponentInChildren<Animator>(); NetworkAnimator netAnim = prefab.GetComponentInChildren<NetworkAnimator>(); log += "Animator is on: " + (anim != null ? anim.gameObject.name : "none") + "\n"; log += "NetworkAnimator is on: " + (netAnim != null ? netAnim.gameObject.name : "none") + "\n"; if (netAnim != null && netAnim.Animator != null) { log += "NetworkAnimator is linked to: " + netAnim.Animator.gameObject.name; } else { log += "NetworkAnimator has NO animator linked!"; } return log; } }
